title: SAE Experiment Runner
summary: This module orchestrates a full suite of experiments for Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), including data generation, encoding, attribution, auto-interpretation, validation, reconstruction analysis, and ablation studies.

nodes.label: Run All Experiments
nodes.title: Run All Experiments
nodes.description: Executes a complete sequence of SAE experiments: generation, encoding, attribution, auto-interpretation, and validation, providing an end-to-end workflow.

nodes.label: Perform Ablation Study
nodes.title: Perform Ablation Study
nodes.description: Conducts an ablation study on SAE features, evaluating their impact on model behavior and generating ablation validation metrics.

nodes.label: Analyze Reconstruction
nodes.title: Analyze Reconstruction
nodes.description: Performs reconstruction diagnostics for SAEs, assessing how well the SAE can reconstruct original activations across various top-k feature selections.

nodes.label: Generate Data
nodes.title: Generate Data for SAEs
nodes.description: Generates synthetic data or prompts to be used as input for SAE experiments, ensuring a consistent dataset for analysis.

nodes.label: Encode Data with SAE
nodes.title: Encode Data with SAE
nodes.description: Encodes the generated data using a specified SAE, producing latent representations for further analysis.

nodes.label: Attribute Features
nodes.title: Attribute SAE Features
nodes.description: Attributes the encoded latent features back to the original input, identifying which features are active for specific inputs.

nodes.label: Auto-Interpret Features
nodes.title: Automated Feature Interpretation
nodes.description: Automatically interprets the attributed SAE features, often by linking them to human-understandable concepts or neuronpedia entries.

nodes.label: Validate SAE Performance
nodes.title: Validate SAE Performance
nodes.description: Validates the overall performance and fidelity of the SAE, comparing its outputs and interpretations against ground truth or expected behaviors.

nodes.label: SAE Causality Analysis
nodes.title: SAE Causality Analysis
nodes.description: Analyzes the causal impact of individual SAE features on model behavior and outputs.

nodes.label: SAE Optimization Scripts
nodes.title: SAE Optimization Scripts
nodes.description: Contains scripts for optimizing SAE training and configuration parameters.

groups.label: Experiment Orchestration
groups.title: SAE Experiment Orchestration
groups.description: Manages the overall flow and execution of various SAE experimental stages, from data preparation to final validation.

groups.label: SAE Lifecycle Steps
groups.title: SAE Lifecycle Steps
groups.description: Individual stages within the SAE experimentation pipeline, including data generation, encoding, feature attribution, and interpretation.

groups.label: Advanced Analysis
groups.title: Advanced SAE Analysis
groups.description: Specialized analyses like ablation studies and reconstruction diagnostics to deeply evaluate SAE behavior and performance.
